discord.description: A bot in one channel, through the REST API

scopes.token: The bot's token (Developer Portal, the application, Bot)
scopes.channel: The channel id (Developer Mode on, right click, Copy Channel ID)

optional.uri: The API with its version; default: https://discord.com/api/v10

scopes.url: The channel's webhook URL (channel settings, Integrations, Webhooks)
